candidates.heuristic_context: Target problem types: excessive communication with customers or external parties, delays caused by repeated information exchanges. Applicable when multiple interactions occur to collect or verify information that could be consolidated.
candidates.additional_context: 'O_Cancelled' runs 20898 times across 15682 cases, and 25% of those cases do it more than once (mean 1.3, max 10). After each one the case sits IDLE for 25.68 h on average against 0.000 h of actual work — the process is waiting on somebody outside it, not on a resource. Consolidating the exchange lowers the repeat probability at gateway node_4683a8e from 25% to 19%. ⚠️ The idle wait is WALL-CLOCK (overnight, weekend, the customer's own delay) and the mined model has no construct for it, so 34.641 h/case is an ESTIMATE from the log, not a simulated result — it is reported beside the measurement and never added to it.
